name: undrudge-apply
description: Clear exactly one open undrudge recommendation belonging to the repository you are already in.

interface.shortDescription: Clear one undrudge rec for the repo you are in.
interface.longDescription: Asks undrudge which open recommendations belong to the current repository, verifies the top one against the live tree, and closes exactly one out: implemented behind a draft PR, dismissed with a reason, or handed back as needing a human.
defaultPrompt: Clear one undrudge recommendation for this repo.
What has undrudge queued for the repo I am in?
